structure: An interior cutaway view of the actual CONNECTED stage and covered passage, viewed from outside the red front balustrade at a low upward angle as photograph a3. THREE consecutive caisson bays extending into depth: a full round coffer over the stage, an octagonal connecting coffer, and the third square-to-round coffer. Preserve the visible front railing, stage deck, columns, transverse beams and elaborately bracketed ceiling. Use a2 to confirm the columns, deck and spatial connections; use a6 only for the main round caisson detail. Do NOT invent an exterior roof or an entire temple, and do not include the shrine hall seen through the courtyard.
materials: weathered dark red-brown timber, red lacquered pillars and railings, faded restrained blue-green, ochre and cream decorative paint on caisson brackets, pale grey stone floor
era: 清道光二十一年起重建
yearNote: 道光二十一年（1841）开始重建戏台，历数年形成三连贯藻井；以开工纪年排序，不把创庙年或完工年混为同一日期。
facts: 道光二十一年（1841）开始重建戏台，历数年建成三连贯藻井。
戏台与勾连廊相接，三座藻井形制不同，按一个连体木构单元收录。
图版从台栏外低视点展示舞台与廊架内部；不把庙门、对面正厅或其他戏台纳入本单体。
